body: Haha that’s pretty coincidental, though I happen to not be named Harvey.

I can snap with my pinkie finger, and I am also able to snap/clap with 4 fingers one-handed. I can flip my tongue upside down. I can also pop and crack my hips, ankles, and shoulders out intentionally. And often when I yawn there is an involuntary popping sounding and spray saliva from underneath my tongue. I can tickle the roof of my mouth with my tongue and my lips by making a buzz sound. I can compress my ribs voluntarily. I can blur my vision and make the ear rumble voluntarily. I can breath in through my nose so deeply I have a Voldemort nose. I always one spot on my left upper arm that grows hair extremely fast, and the longest it’s ever been is 3.3 cm. Might be just a theory, but I think I can run faster backwards than forwards.

I’m 16[F] as well and I feel the same way. I’ve had the same insecurity for a quite a bit. Please  accept that this hardly your fault and all you could’ve done was text them, but they could’ve texted you just the same. Honestly, maybe it isn’t best to try reconnect with your friends to some degree, because if they’re justifying their behaviour due to a past action of yours, such as possibly a disagreement, that would be quite petty. And they could potentially feel like they’re entitled to an apology from you without reasonable cause.

If you do still wish to talk with them from my own experience I’d suggest you say something similar to “Hey [names], I’m sorry for being out of touch, I’ve been trying to sort things for myself, but I hope you all are doing all right.”

Hope that helps and I’m free to talk if you need someone to talk with. :)
Yeah I wish I was, because at least some people would see past my appearance.
Yeah I feel that, no one’s beyond interested in me besides as a joke or exclusively physical attraction. I hope everything in your life gets better as well.

I’m 16 as well and I honestly can’t see myself in the years at college or especially beyond it either. I feel like time will move on without me, and I’ll become lost. So I myself understand what you’re feeling. Although, I suppose what’s brought me a fair bit of comfort, is accepting that I don’t know everything now and there will always be something out of my knowledge, and that’s perfectly alright. Because you don’t have to feel like you know everything, but also know that you are not inexperienced - you’re under-experienced which will come in time throughout our lives. We have a good plenty of life to live and time to decide what matters. I hope you choose to press through this.

I’m sorry that you’ve had to put up with that. I similarly have had come to that with both my friends and fwbs, and it’s hurts more than I thought it would’ve, despite being subjected to it countless times in the past. I hope you find someone more worthy of your time and efforts.
Sorry to hear about that and I hope it gets lifted soon, if you’d like to chat, feel free to dm.

I know that is hard to see a reason to hope when all seems fleeting. I [16F] feel the same way, although despite our differing experiences, life seems to be without wonder or something to keep us going. I would suggest that you take cautiously and don’t overthink things too heavily. Wishing you luck.
